headline_ur: 4 سال خریدیں، 1 سال مفت حاصل کریں

8.1.en:
New Features:
  • Input tool now supports Arabic and Persian.
  • Quranic surah and verses can now be added using the input tool in Urdu, Arabic and Persian mode.
  • Writing the first two words of a Quran verse also gives the entire verse suggestions.
  • Added a feature where inserting Quran verses can automatically put diacritics on them which can be toggled on/off.
  • Improved the font change to make it more efficient.
  • Added a feature where translation popup of a highlighted text is now scrollable as well as collapseable.
  • Added the writing board tool (Pro Only) for taking notes or writing blogs or articles
  • Added a proofreading tool (Pro Only) for correcting written mistakes for Input tool modes.
  • Added the (About Us) option in the settings menu to connect with our socials
  • Added the (Rate Us) option to help users rate the extension. This will help developer a lot.
Patch Notes:
  • Fixed the issue where pressing the back icon caused viewport or scroll drift to the bottom of the page on social media sites.
  • Fixed the issue where highlighting a text using highlighter caused increase in the text size.
  • Fixed an issue where using input tool on some social media sites caused ghost words.
  • Fixed an issue where input tool blocked writing on some social media sites.
  • Fixed an issue where writing using input tool blocked deletion on some social media sites
  • Fixed an issue where translating the highlighted text caused the popup to remain stuck on the screen
  • Choosing the highlighter color no longer requires clicking on the arrow icon, users can now hover their mouse to select highlighter colors
  • Switching or turning off the input tool no longer needs Alt+Shift+I, Pressing the Alt+I key will open the modal for switching as well as turning off input mode.
  • Changed the UI so that tools will now be easily available at the top.
  • Improved the detection efficiency of Urdu sublanguages as well as persian and arabic
  • Fixed minor errors that appeared in the extension tab
8.1.ur: عربی اور فارسی ان پٹ کو ٹھیک کیا، نیا لینگویج پکر شامل کیا، اور X.com پر کئی بگز درست کیے۔
